articles.summary: SOPHiA GENETICS is excited to announce the launch of SOPHiA DDM™ Dispatch, a new way for our SOPHiA GENETICS Integrated Access partner labs to work with their clients. SOPHiA DDM™ Dispatch make its it easier to work with clients directly and control logistics within your lab. The post The Launch of SOPHiA DDM™ Dispatch appeared first on SOPHiA GENETICS .
